docket_entries.description: SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL [AGENT FOR SERVICE - INCORPORATING SERVICES, LTD] FILED BY PLAINTIFF WEI, WEIXI AS TO DEFENDANT TURO INC.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED JUN-20-2024, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT TURO INC.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF WEIXI WEI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT TURO INC. IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF STATED BOTH PARTIES HAVE REACHED A SETTLEMENT AND HE WOULD THIS MATTER DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: CARL CHAMBERLIN; CLERK: D. CARTER. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $12,000.00 FILED BY WEI, WEIXI AS TO DEFENDANT TURO INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-09-2024 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
